description:
Implement the report domain (currently a stub at domain/report/doc.go) to aggregate validation results into the report formats the meta-optimization team expects.

Report types needed:
- --conflicts: Cross-skill contradictions (skills connected to same reference with incompatible structural expectations or overlapping CLI assertions producing different expected values)
- --drift: Skills whose content hash changed since their connection was established (drift detection already exists in skill domain — this aggregates across all connections)
- --maturity: Skill maturity scoring based on expectation coverage (skills with few or no expectations = low maturity, skills with comprehensive structural + CLI expectations = high maturity)
- --tool-baselines: Tool accuracy regression checks (run CLI assertions for scenario-auditor, test-genie, scenario-completeness-scoring against references, compare results to stored baselines)

Scope:
- Implement report service with methods for each report type
- Create report models for structured output
- Create HTTP handlers for report endpoints
- Wire into main.go
- Depends on dtv-validation-api because reports aggregate validation results
name: dtv-report-generation
title: Report Domain Implementation
